name: Implement itertools.batched

source.note: Minimized from GH-98363 / GH-98364: the documented pure-Python recipe for itertools.batched. Standalone module; does not import CPython's C helper.

description: Implement batched(iterable, n) as added to CPython 3.12. It must lazily consume the input and yield lists of length n, with the final list allowed to be shorter. n < 1 must raise ValueError('n must be at least one'). The seed currently dumps the whole iterable into a single list and ignores batching. Do not import itertools.batched from the standard library; implement the recipe locally.
